title: swordAI
tagline: AI agent that bridges, lends, borrows across Morpho, Yearn, Sushi for best yields, ofc on Katana
description: An autonomous DeFi yield agent that scans Morpho, Yearn, and SushiSwap for the best net yields, plans a step-by-step strategy (including 1:1 bridging when needed via AggLayer), and then executes it end-to-end on your behalf. Example flow: bridge 2 ETH → lend on Morpho → borrow stables at negative APY (incentives) → either provide stable LP on Sushi V3 or lock into a Yearn vault—whichever gives the highest after-fee, after-gas return—while enforcing strict risk, slippage, and permissions guardrails.
